remarks: WATERFRONT SUNRISES ON NORWALK HARBOR! This apartment was recently built in an iconic Norwalk Harbor building. It features high-ceilings, new energy efficient appliances, in-unit washer/dryer, 2 beds, and 2 full baths. Hardwood floors throughout. Elevator in building. From the paint to the fixtures, everything is brand new!  Outside amenities include: dining tables/chairs, adirondack chairs, gas fire pit, and gas grills. Future plans include: kayak/paddle board racks and boat slips!  Only two units available. No HOA! You will be a few blocks away from South Norwalk Train Station and I95. Walk or bike to all SONO & East Norwalk amenities, beaches (Calf Pasture & Shady), shops, restaurants, SoNo nightlife, Maritime Museum & Aquarium, the SoNo Collection Mall.  Submit rental application, credit report, employment verification, photo ID & references through Rent Spree application or Tenant screening service your office uses.
